title: WP900 G10 trial wire must prove factory-valid source-mediator origin rather than only self-consistent JSON
target: F2-WP-900 generation 10 independent semantic mediator authority candidate

material_observation.claim_strength: IndependentSemanticMediatorReceipt.observe requires a factory-valid GWT uptake, independent source-range event and LIVE GWT runtime witness bound to the exact semantic payload bytes. G10 CI and deterministic release CI are green for source commit 5aace808e6f88e9b496aa1c2fc5c10d638ce8630.
material_observation.remaining_origin_gap: MediatedSemanticState.from_wire validates only the wire JSON shape, a body_sha256 recomputable by any caller, frozen plan/oracle consistency, and text/SHA formatting. It does not validate that the serialized body was emitted by a factory-valid IndependentSemanticMediatorReceipt or that source_range_sha256/runtime_witness_sha256/exact_source_sha256/boot_id_sha256 correspond to any real source receipt after serialization.
material_observation.causal_consequence: A caller with the frozen plan can construct a complete synthetic body for the preregistered semantic class, fill source/runtime identity fields with arbitrary syntactically valid values, recompute body_sha256, and obtain a factory-sealed MediatedSemanticState without executing IndependentSemanticMediatorReceipt.observe or any GWT source event. The current sham-wire regression deletes a required field, so it does not exercise this complete-origin forgery.

constructive_counterexample.setup: Construct an envelope with schema FRANKENSTEIN2_G10_INDEPENDENT_SEMANTIC_MEDIATOR_WIRE/v1 and a complete body matching SEMANTIC_MEDIATOR_RECEIPT_SCHEMA. Set plan_sha256 and semantic_slot_ref from the frozen plan, choose a trial_position and canonical_semantic_json whose oracle class matches the preregistered trial order, use arbitrary lowercase 64-hex values for raw_payload/source-range/runtime-witness/exact-source/boot digests, use an arbitrary source_process_identity distinct from the supplied trial_process_identity, then recompute body_sha256 over the fabricated body.
constructive_counterexample.expected_current_behavior: MediatedSemanticState.from_wire accepts the forged packet because all checks are self-consistency checks over attacker-controlled serialized fields plus the public frozen plan/oracle.
constructive_counterexample.required_behavior: Reject unless wire origin is bound to a factory-valid source mediator authority artifact that cannot be recreated by the trial-side caller merely by recomputing public digests.

required_discriminator_before_vps_bindin: Add a regression that fabricates a complete syntactically valid mediator body with recomputed body_sha256 but without calling IndependentSemanticMediatorReceipt.observe; it MUST be rejected before any behavioral execution.

Change the Wire -> MediatedSemanticState admission ABI so acceptance requires verifiable origin from the factory-valid source mediator authority, not only a self-hash. At repository scope, the minimal repair may require an exact factory-valid mediator receipt plus byte-for-byte equality to receipt.to_wire(); target process independence must remain zero-credit until a cross-process origin mechanism is executed and bound.

Do not treat caller-supplied source_process_identity strings as process-independence evidence. Target execution must bind actual source/trial/executor process identities or equivalent independently observed runtime identities.
Rerun G10 targeted CI and deterministic release CI after repair, then repeat independent ABI review before binding any VPS subject.
scope_fence: This candidate does not invalidate terminal G9 evidence and does not claim G10 runtime failure. It blocks only G10 repository acceptance and any target/VPS binding until origin authenticity is repaired and regression-tested. All G10 runtime/semantic/J-Space credits remain zero.
next_exact_action: G10 owner should add the complete-origin-forgery regression and repair Wire -> MediatedSemanticState admission so a trial-side caller cannot mint source-authority metadata by recomputing public hashes. Keep VPS subject unbound and all higher credits at zero until repaired CI and independent review pass.
